notes: Folded from 44 one-function sources (Mg_FreeBannerFiles .. func_ov004_020b4aa0). Mg_LoadBannerFiles had no complete delinks entry before, but it byte-matched; what it lacked was a licence for the 0xe8-byte table its local array initializer copies from. A local `Entry entries[29] = {...}` makes mwccarm emit that table as an anonymous input .rodata object (@N), while the cartridge keeps it in the module's .data at 0x020bc6e8, which the intact-object link cannot place from .rodata. The unit therefore defines it as an ordinary initialized global under its configured name sMgBannerFileTemplate, and the function copies it with a plain struct copy; the emitted instructions are the same.

`#pragma defer_codegen off` is load-bearing: the shards' file-global opt_propagation (Banner_DrawSqueeze, Banner_DrawZoomA, Banner_DrawZoomB) pragmas bind to their one function only with undeferred codegen, which also makes the source ROM-ascending.

The per-source extern declarations disagreed on type for several symbols (sMgBannerFiles and data_ov006_021346bc as int vs pointer, Mg_RenderSpriteOn's argument widths, Banner_StartWaveBurst's return type); the single declaration set in the unit source picks one spelling each and the bodies cast to match. Banner_UpdateFall became void: no caller uses a result, and the void body compiles to the same bytes.

Two-word struct copies (Banner_StartSpin, Banner_StartWaveBurst, Banner_Press) go through W2, a struct whose only member is an int[2]; plain {int a, b} structs scalarize under C++ and miss the ROM's block move.

Text and the one template only: this unit's bss (0x020bf3e8..0x020bf9e4, including the static array at gMgBanners) stays ROM-owned and is reached by extern, as the one-function sources did; __sinit_ov004_020b955c stays its own enrolled source.
